items.text: Sheep now drop the wool they were wearing at the moment of death.
Lambs no longer drop dung, matching calf behavior.
Sheep dung drop bug fixed.

Added regular and rich mutton pies: halve the time for livestock to reach Bonded status (can be led) and prevent bulls from charging; the rich version reduces bonding time by an additional 30 seconds.
Added regular and rich beef pies: increase the maximum food duration by +75% (875 calories) and boost downed‑player recovery chance to 75% (regular) or 100% (rich) after the hunger bar is full.
Mount prompt no longer appears when no animal is being led.
Mounting slots now specify supported animal size (large or small).
Cows can no longer be placed in the small flatbed; they require the large flatbed.
Fixed an additional edge case where the store could break when the player has no items.
Bad genes are now more common, making generic‑looking sheep and cows prevalent; good genes (e.g., black sheep) have become rarer.
Reduced category button width by two pixels to stop overflow in the crafting menu.
Fixed fractional reloads for the mini crossbow, ensuring proper reload behavior.
Added a ridable horse prefab, allowing players to mount horses.
Fixed boat power‑down mechanic when lowering sails and jumping off quickly, preventing uncontrolled drifting.
Adjusted collider sizes for livestock and critter animals, improving hit detection and interaction.
Added sheep trophy head to hunting trophies and corrected ragdoll display for male calves in female bodies.
Fixed door controllers on external gates to persist correctly when upgraded via SimpleUpgrade.
Resolved deployables clipping through doors and disappearing when exterior doors close.
Added fuseboxes to all monuments that contain them, restoring functionality for players.
Added a 15‑minute start delay to oil pump operation; total cycle now 20 min + 15 min delay.
Implemented broken helipad stages for the Airwolf repairable pad, affecting helipad functionality.
Introduced configurable tolerance for deployable placement on deformed terrain and ensured foundations align to original terrain height, preventing placement over deep carves.
Fixed fractional reloads for the mini crossbow, restoring proper reload behavior.
Added a sheep trophy head to the hunting trophy prefab, giving players a new trophy item from sheep hunts.
Placed fusebox items in all monuments that contain fuseboxes, making them available for players to interact with or loot.
Adjusted item placement logic to use MoveToContainer and set default position to -1 for legacy loadout files, fixing loadout position bugs.
Introduced a ridable horse prefab, providing a new mount option for players.
Resolved issue where lowering sails and quickly jumping off could prevent the boat power‑down, causing the boat to drift away.
Fixed external gate door controllers to persist correctly after upgrades, preventing loss of functionality.
Deployables no longer become hidden when an exterior door closes, fixing clipping issues.
Introduced configurable tolerance for deployables on deformed terrain and ensured foundations align with original terrain height, preventing placement errors over deep carves.
Implemented new UI for the biofuel generator with a progress bar and minor mount/dismount adjustments.
Added a 15‑minute delay to the oil pump start, extending the rig timer to 20 minutes plus the configured start delay.
Fixed broken helipad stage setup, restoring proper helipad functionality.

2026-09-21.summary:
### Combat & Weapons
- Fixed fractional reloads for the mini crossbow, restoring proper reload behavior.

### Items, Crafting & Inventory
- Added a sheep trophy head to the hunting trophy prefab, giving players a new trophy item from sheep hunts.
- Placed fusebox items in all monuments that contain fuseboxes, making them available for players to interact with or loot.
- Adjusted item placement logic to use MoveToContainer and set default position to -1 for legacy loadout files, fixing loadout position bugs.

### Vehicles & Boats
- Introduced a ridable horse prefab, providing a new mount option for players.
- Resolved issue where lowering sails and quickly jumping off could prevent the boat power‑down, causing the boat to drift away.

### Structures & Deployables
- Fixed external gate door controllers to persist correctly after upgrades, preventing loss of functionality.
- Deployables no longer become hidden when an exterior door closes, fixing clipping issues.
- Introduced configurable tolerance for deployables on deformed terrain and ensured foundations align with original terrain height, preventing placement errors over deep carves.
- Implemented new UI for the biofuel generator with a progress bar and minor mount/dismount adjustments.

### Facilities
- Added a 15‑minute delay to the oil pump start, extending the rig timer to 20 minutes plus the configured start delay.
- Fixed broken helipad stage setup, restoring proper helipad functionality.

items.text: Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.
Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

2026-09-20.summary:
### Base Building
- Building is now blocked within a radius of sandbag pillboxes, preventing structures from being placed directly on or too close to them.

### Livestock & Animals
- Sheep automatically unlead when mounted and re‑lead after dismount, with updated mount/dismount animations.

### Item Durability
- Condition (durability) has been disabled for diving masks, crate & barrel costumes, prisoner hoods, sunglasses, geiger counters, metal detectors, RF pagers, and mobile phones, so these items no longer degrade.

items.text: Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.
Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.

2026-09-19.summary:
### Livestock & Animal Behavior
- Leading livestock now works reliably and shows a visible rope.
- Livestock headbutt damage increased; bulls no longer attack in safe zones; leading bulls stop fighting others; grazing through walls fixed; stop‑leading prompt bug fixed.
- Livestock avoidance speed doubled, making them steer away from obstacles faster.
- Bulls no longer attempt headbutts on unreachable players.
- Animals no longer get stuck circling obstacles when fleeing or charging.

### UI & Store
- Store no longer shows a 'content failed to load' error when your inventory is empty.
